name: Showcase — Checkout & OTP (pre-baked)
raw_input:
Customers must pay with card or wallet within 10 seconds.

Inventory must decrement atomically when an order is confirmed.

SLA: p95 checkout API latency under 300ms for 1k concurrent users.
